settings.heading: Crafting Timeless Furniture For Modern Sanctuary
settings.subheading: At FurniCraft, we merge traditional artisan woodworking with clean, contemporary architectural aesthetics. Every piece is handcrafted from certified sustainable hardwoods to bring lasting warmth, refinement, and luxury to your everyday living.

settings.heading: Numbers That Reflect Our Dedication
settings.subheading: Built on trust, sustainable forestry, and generations of craftsmanship.

settings.title: Precision Hand-Joinery
settings.description: Engineered with classic mortise, tenon, and dovetail joints for lasting structural integrity.

settings.title: Natural Organic Finishes
settings.description: Zero harmful VOCs—treated with natural linseed and plant oils that enhance natural wood grain.

settings.title: Heirloom Generational Quality
settings.description: Furniture created not just for today, but to be passed down through generations.

settings.heading: From Raw Timber To Refined Masterpieces
settings.text: True luxury lies in the details you cannot always see. Our master carpenters hand-select seasoned logs, carving and joining each corner with time-honored methods that withstand decades of use.

settings.title: Sustainable Hardwoods
settings.description: We exclusively harvest from responsibly managed plantations, guaranteeing environmental harmony and zero deforestation.

settings.title: Artisan Craftsmanship
settings.description: Hand-joined by veteran carpenters with decades of mastery, resulting in unmatched strength and finish.

settings.title: Timeless Modern Design
settings.description: Thoughtful proportions designed to seamlessly complement modern apartments and heritage homes alike.

settings.title: Direct-to-Consumer Luxury
settings.description: By eliminating retail showroom markups and middleman margins, we offer true heirloom quality at fair prices.

settings.heading: Built On Uncompromising Principles
settings.subheading: Our philosophy guides every cut, joint, finish, and customer relationship.

settings.title: Architectural Blueprint
settings.description: Every silhouette starts with precision hand-sketched blueprints focused on ergonomics, structural balance, and modern proportions.

settings.title: Hardwood Selection
settings.description: We hand-inspect each seasoned plank for moisture content, natural grain flow, and density before cutting.

settings.title: Master Hand-Crafting
settings.description: Artisans cut, plane, and joint each component with traditional mortise-and-tenon craftsmanship and organic oil sanding.

settings.title: White Glove Delivery
settings.description: Each finished piece is custom-crated and delivered directly into your room of choice with hassle-free assembly.

settings.heading: Our Four-Stage Creation Journey
settings.subheading: From rough forest logs to the centerpiece of your living space.

settings.heading: Ready To Bring Heirloom Luxury Into Your Home?
settings.subheading: Explore our curated living, bedroom, and dining collections, or reach out to our design consultants for bespoke custom orders.
